critical_code_review_comments: PremiumReadyBanner + PremiumReadyOverlay share a large amount of stylistic scaffolding (background gradient, ambient blur blobs, Crown+ShieldCheck badges, Sparkles+Open button, chapters strip). Consider extracting a shared `<PremiumCelebrationChrome>` primitive to prevent visual drift over time.
PremiumReadyOverlay uses `AnimatePresence` correctly and does not mount when `open=false`, so the DOM stays clean and testable — good.

The banner's `onOpenReport` fallback `window.scrollTo({top: window.innerHeight * 0.5})` is graceful. Verified live: scores grid is above the viewport-half point on desktop, so it kicks in only if the anchor node is missing (should not happen in practice).
ReportPage.jsx is now 3250 lines — still deferred split from S126 review. Not blocking S130, but a refactor sweep is overdue.

PremiumReadyBanner's outer <motion.section> has no rounded corner class while the button + card use volt/dark theme — visually the sharp corners are on-brand (Barlow uppercase / brutalist), just noting in case future design polish adds radius.

UploadPage skipHeroTeaser branching relies on `isPaidTier` at submit time; if a user upgrades mid-upload (edge case) the wrong overlay could show. Not observed as a real bug — call out for future consideration only.
